Hi there,

The light is lower and the evenings are longer, so we made furniture for exactly that. The Hearth Collection is four pieces in oak, walnut, brass and bouclé, drawn in our studio and built to be used every day for a very long time.

Each one is available to order from today.

From the workshop

Drawn by hand, then made by it

Every Hearth piece starts as a pencil line on a board. Lead designer Ines Halvard works at full scale on the bench, so a curve is judged by eye and by hand before it is ever cut.

“If a joint is honest, you never have to hide it,” she says. So we don’t.
